name: Solo Display
author: js
description: Indicator toggle that turns off all displays but one, gathers workspaces onto it, and restores the full setup afterwards

barWidget.description: Keep one display on and gather workspaces onto it

schema.label: Display
schema.description: Connector to keep on, e.g. DP-1 or HDMI-A-1. Empty uses the focused display. Right-click the indicator to pick one.

schema.label: Workspaces
schema.description: Workspaces pinned to that display while solo mode is on: a comma list and/or ranges, e.g. 1-5.

schema.label: Suspend widget
schema.description: Bar widget taken off the bar while solo mode is on and put back, settings intact, afterwards. Empty keeps the bar as is.

schema.label: Stand-in widget
schema.description: Widget shown in the suspended widget's place while solo mode is on. Empty leaves the slot empty.

schema.label: Always Show
schema.description: Show the indicator while inactive without waiting for hover.
